claims.quote: For too long, people have put up with a railway that often lets them down.
claims.statement: The railway has often let people down, and people have put up with it for too long.

claims.quote: Today is another big step forward.
claims.statement: The announcement is another big step forward.

claims.quote: The biggest shake-up to our railways in a generation is underway.
claims.statement: The biggest shake-up to the railways in a generation is underway.

claims.quote: Great British Railways will bring the railway together around one mission - better services for passengers - with Derby at the heart of its future.
claims.statement: Great British Railways will bring the railway together around the mission of better services for passengers, with Derby at the heart of its future.

claims.quote: This foundation apprenticeship will give young people the chance to explore career paths within the sector at an exciting time, developing their technical knowledge and skillset while earning.
claims.statement: The foundation apprenticeship will let young people explore career paths in the rail sector while developing technical skills and earning.

claims.quote: This is fantastic news for Derby.
claims.statement: The announcement that Great British Railways will be based in Derby is fantastic news for the city.

facts.quote: the site of Great British Railways’ (GBR) headquarters is unveiled today (15 October 2026) in Derby
facts.statement: The site of the Great British Railways headquarters was unveiled in Derby on 15 October 2026.

facts.quote: Becketwell, a brownfield site in the heart of Derby city centre
facts.statement: Becketwell is a brownfield site in the heart of Derby city centre and is the location of the new GBR headquarters.

facts.quote: The site will accommodate up to 450 GBR staff
facts.statement: The Becketwell headquarters site will accommodate up to 450 GBR staff.

facts.quote: Up to 600 apprentices between 16 and 21 years old will enrol over the next 4 years on the rail foundation apprenticeship
facts.statement: Up to 600 apprentices aged 16 to 21 will enrol over the next four years on the rail foundation apprenticeship.

facts.quote: fares frozen for the first time in 30 years
facts.statement: Fares have been frozen for the first time in 30 years.

facts.quote: the recent £1 billion investment in a new fleet of trains for the north set to be built at Alstom’s Derby site
facts.statement: There has been a recent £1 billion investment in a new fleet of trains for the north, set to be built at Alstom’s Derby site.

facts.quote: less than 7% of the railway’s workforce is under 25
facts.statement: Less than 7% of the railway’s workforce is under 25.

facts.quote: Work and Pensions Secretary Pat McFadden said:
facts.statement: Work and Pensions Secretary Pat McFadden made a statement on the announcement.

facts.quote: Mayor of the East Midlands, Claire Ward, said:
facts.statement: Mayor of the East Midlands Claire Ward made a statement on the announcement.
